items.bold: "PROJECT FREEDOM": Trump announces US will escort ships out of Hormuz starting Monday. Brent slumps 2.45%.
items.text: CBS News (4 hours ago) confirmed: President Trump on Sunday announced "Project Freedom" — an effort to escort ships not involved in the war with Iran out of the Strait of Hormuz, beginning Monday. This is the most significant new US operational move since the naval blockade began April 13. Brent crude slumped as much as 2.45% in Monday's session on the news. "Project Freedom" changes the strategic calculus: if the US can successfully escort commercial vessels through Hormuz without Iran attacking them, Iran's chokehold on the strait is broken WITHOUT a deal. This gives the US significant additional leverage — and explains why Iran's IRGC previously warned that any military vessel approaching the strait would be considered a ceasefire violation.

military.t: "PROJECT FREEDOM": US Escorting Ships Out of Hormuz Starting Monday. Brent Slumps 2.45%.
military.d: CBS News (4 hours ago) confirmed: President Trump on Sunday announced "Project Freedom" — an effort to escort ships not involved in the war with Iran out of the Strait of Hormuz, beginning Monday. Brent crude slumped as much as 2.45% in Monday's session on the news. This is the most significant new US Hormuz operational move since the naval blockade began April 13. Strategic implications: (1) If escort missions succeed without Iranian attack, Iran's chokehold on Hormuz is broken WITHOUT a deal — fundamentally shifts the negotiating balance. (2) Iran previously warned any military vessel approaching the strait is a ceasefire violation and would meet "severe response" — an Iranian attack on escort vessels risks resuming full war. (3) Trump can claim progress on Hormuz without conceding on nuclear — separating the two issues that have been linked throughout the war.

military.t: Lebanon: IDF Evacuating More Towns. Hezbollah Drone Strikes. Project Freedom Risk: Iran Retaliation.
military.d: CBS News (live blog) confirmed: IDF evacuating more southern Lebanon towns with Hezbollah drone strikes continuing. Israel's IDF says it will occupy southern Lebanon until Hezbollah threat completely removed. Lebanon displacement: more than 1 million people displaced per Lebanese authorities. Iran has linked Hormuz to Lebanon throughout the war — Lebanon escalation remains the structural complication for any comprehensive deal. Critical risk for Project Freedom: if Iran's IRGC attacks US escort vessels, it constitutes a direct attack on the US military during ceasefire — Trump would have full justification for immediate resumed strikes. The IRGC previously warned "any military vessel approaching the strait would be considered a ceasefire violation." Project Freedom tests whether Iran will back down from that threat or follow through.

assessment.headline: DAY 66, 10AM MON: "PROJECT FREEDOM" — US escorting ships through Hormuz starting today. Brent -2.45%. Sensex +931. Nifty +282. Maruti record sales. State elections: DMK TN, UDF Kerala, WB close. Iran 14-pt proposal under review.
assessment.body:
Monday 10 AM IST. Day 66. The West Asia War just gained a new operational dimension.

"PROJECT FREEDOM" — WHAT IT MEANS
• Trump announced Sunday: US will escort ships not involved in the war out of Hormuz starting Monday
• Brent slumped 2.45% on the news — markets pricing partial Hormuz reopening
• This is the most significant new US Hormuz move since the blockade began April 13

THE STRATEGIC CALCULATION SHIFT
• If Project Freedom escort succeeds without Iranian attack:
  — Iran's Hormuz chokehold broken WITHOUT a deal
  — Iran loses its primary negotiating leverage
  — US can claim Hormuz progress without conceding on nuclear
• If Iran attacks escort vessels:
  — Direct attack on US military during ceasefire
  — Full justification for immediate resumed strikes
  — Brent spikes to $140-150, war enters most dangerous phase
• This is a brilliant strategic move: Iran must choose between letting ships through (losing leverage) or attacking (risking full war)

INDIA'S MONDAY — DUAL POSITIVE
• Sensex +931 to 77,845. Nifty +282 to 24,279
• Project Freedom: Brent easing = OMC hike possibly deferred
• Elections: DMK TN, UDF Kerala, WB close — stability signal
• Maruti record sales: +33% YoY — consumer demand intact
• Auto, Realty, Metal leading. IT and banks weak.

THE KEY QUESTION FOR INDIA
• Do India-flagged tankers qualify for Project Freedom escort?
• If yes: India crude imports resume through Hormuz
• If yes: Gulf fertiliser imports restart — kharif season salvageable
• MEA must urgently engage the US on this today

VERDICT: "Project Freedom" is Trump's most creative strategic move of the war. It simultaneously breaks Iran's Hormuz leverage, tests the ceasefire framework, and creates a path to Hormuz reopening that doesn't require a nuclear deal. For India, it is the most positive Hormuz development since the brief April 17 opening. But the critical question is Iran's response — which will define the rest of this week.

featured.desc: India imports 30%+ of its fertilisers via the Strait of Hormuz. This paper maps the supply chain risks to kharif and rabi crops, the strategic case for diversification, and what a prolonged blockade means for food security.
